# Grammar patterns

36 patterns of everyday spoken Cantonese, each with at least three example sentences in 漢字, Jyutping, Yale, Bopomofo and English.

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

## A1

| Pattern | Jyutping | Meaning | Topic |

|---|---|---|---|

| [Subject + 係 + Noun](hai6-copula.md) | Subject + hai6 + Noun | to be (identity) | Being and having |
| [唔 + Verb / Adjective](m4-negation.md) | m4 + Verb / Adjective | not | Negation |
| [有 / 冇 + Noun](jau5-mou5.md) | jau5 / mou5 + Noun | to have; there is / there isn't | Being and having |
| [有冇 + Noun？](jau5-mou5-question.md) | jau5 mou5 + Noun? | Is there…? / Do you have…? | Asking questions |
| [Verb + 唔 + Verb？](a-not-a-question.md) | Verb + m4 + Verb? | yes/no question (A-not-A) | Asking questions |
| [Verb + 咗](zo2-completed.md) | Verb + zo2 | completed action | Time and aspect |
| [Verb + 緊](gan2-progressive.md) | Verb + gan2 | in the middle of doing (-ing) | Time and aspect |
| [Noun / Pronoun + 嘅 + Noun](ge3-possessive.md) | Noun / Pronoun + ge3 + Noun | 's / of (possession and description) | Possession and description |
| [Subject + 喺 + Place](hai2-location.md) | Subject + hai2 + Place | to be at / in | Location and pointing |
| [呢 / 嗰 + Classifier (+ Noun)](ni1-go2-demonstratives.md) | ni1 / go2 + Classifier (+ Noun) | this / that | Location and pointing |
| [Number + Classifier + Noun](number-classifier.md) | Number + Classifier + Noun | counting things | Counting |
| [想 + Verb](soeng2-want.md) | soeng2 + Verb | would like to / want to | Wants, needs and ability |
| [要 + Noun / Verb](jiu3-want-need.md) | jiu3 + Noun / Verb | to want (something); to need to / have to | Wants, needs and ability |
| [好 + Adjective](hou2-very.md) | hou2 + Adjective | very | Degree and comparison |
| [… 幾多錢？](gei2-do1-cin2.md) | … gei2 do1 cin2? | How much is…? | Asking questions |
| [乜嘢 / 咩](mat1-je5-what.md) | mat1 je5 / me1 | what | Asking questions |
| [邊度 / 邊個 / 邊 + Classifier](bin1-where-who.md) | bin1 dou6 / bin1 go3 / bin1 + Classifier | where / who / which | Asking questions |
| [幾時 + Verb？](gei2-si4-when.md) | gei2 si4 + Verb? | when | Asking questions |
| [… 呀](aa3-softener.md) | … aa3 | friendly softener for questions and replies | Sentence-final particles |
| [… 啦](laa1-suggestion.md) | … laa1 | suggestion, invitation or gentle request | Sentence-final particles |
| [… 嗎？](maa3-question.md) | … maa3? | neutral yes/no question | Sentence-final particles |
| [A + 同 + B](tung4-and-with.md) | A + tung4 + B | and; with | Connecting words |

| Pattern | Jyutping | Meaning | Topic |

|---|---|---|---|

| [… 咩？](me1-surprise.md) | … me1? | surprised question ('really?') | Sentence-final particles |
| [Subject + 都 + Verb](dou1-also.md) | Subject + dou1 + Verb | also; both / all | Connecting words |
| [畀 + Thing + Person](bei2-give.md) | bei2 + Thing + Person | to give | Connecting words |

| [A + Adjective + 過 + B](gwo3-comparison.md) | A + Adjective + gwo3 + B | A is more … than B | Degree and comparison |
